concept: Not wasting resources like water, food, or materials
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character notices they're wasting something (water running, food thrown out) and changes their habit
exercise.reflection_prompt: What small change did the character make, and why did it matter?
exercise.practice: Student names one small way they could waste less at home

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific, realistic habit change
